inputs.name: adguardhome_version
inputs.description: AdGuard Home release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, from the release's checksums.txt. Change these with adguardhome_version.

inputs.name: admin_username
inputs.description: User name for the web interface and the API.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password for the web interface and the API. It reaches the host in a root-only file, is hashed there with bcrypt, and never reaches the plan or state.

inputs.name: web_address
inputs.description: Address and port of the web interface and the API. "0.0.0.0:3000" listens on every address.

inputs.name: dns_bind_hosts
inputs.description: Addresses AdGuard Home answers DNS on, port 53. "0.0.0.0" means every address, IPv4 and IPv6.

inputs.name: allowed_clients
inputs.description: Clients AdGuard Home answers, as addresses or CIDR networks. Everyone else is refused. The default is loopback and the private ranges. An empty list answers anyone who can reach port 53.

inputs.name: upstream_dns
inputs.description: Servers AdGuard Home forwards allowed queries to, in its upstream syntax: "https://..." for DNS over HTTPS, "tls://..." for DNS over TLS, or a plain address such as "192.168.1.1" or "127.0.0.1:5335". The default is Quad9 and Cloudflare over HTTPS.

inputs.name: bootstrap_dns
inputs.description: Plain DNS servers, by address, that look up the names in upstream_dns, such as dns.quad9.net.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: Blocklists, names to URLs. Adblock-style lists, hosts files and plain domain lists all work.

inputs.name: user_rules
inputs.description: Filtering rules of your own, in AdGuard's syntax, such as ["||ads.example.com^", "@@||allowed.example.com^"].

inputs.name: rewrites
inputs.description: DNS rewrites for local names, domains to an IP address or another domain, such as { "nas.home.arpa" = "192.168.1.20" }. A domain can start with *. to cover its subdomains.

inputs.name: blocking_mode
inputs.description: How AdGuard Home answers a blocked query: "default" (0.0.0.0 or :: for Adblock-style rules, the rule's address for hosts-style ones), "null_ip", "nxdomain" or "refused".
